# Hiscox

> > Hiscox is a specialist insurer providing business and personal insurance solutions with identity and access management capabilities.

Hiscox operates an Identity Portal that enables centralized access control, policy management, and reporting for its digital services. The platform supports identity management workflows, rule-based access policies, and comprehensive search capabilities for enterprise security administration.

## Key Topics

- Hiscox
- Identity Portal
- Identity Management
- Access Control
- Policy Management
- Dashboard
- Reporting
- Search Interface
- Rule Engine
- Enterprise Security
- Authentication
- Authorization
